summary: Yakima County, WA summit: a 20-foot L-4 pole tower reported built 1935 (1934 panoramas show earlier work), destroyed in 1976; footings remain and a trail reaches the summit.

facts.design: 20-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; FireLookout.com also lists an L-6 ground cab
facts.status_note: The last tower was destroyed in 1976 (FireLookout.com, WillhiteWeb); the register says removed in 1976. The register describes concrete footings farther back and tie-downs near the south edge.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Wenatchee National Forest; now Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest)

access.note: Forest Service trailhead at the end of Forest Road 530, reached by a 7.2-mile rough gravel road. Wilderness regulations apply.

visit.trail_note: Round Mountain Trail from the Indian Springs trailhead off Forest Road 530; WTA lists 5.2 miles round trip. There is no tower to climb.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Most sources date the 20-foot tower to 1935. WillhiteWeb notes the July 1934 panoramas already show cut trees and some wires, so the story gives both dates without settling which came first.
FireLookout.com and WillhiteWeb say the last tower was destroyed in 1976; the register and the Forest Lookouts page say it was removed. The story uses destroyed and mentions the register's version.

notes_for_editor: Built year conflict: 1935 (register, FireLookout.com, WillhiteWeb reporting) vs July 1934 panoramas that WillhiteWeb says already show cut trees and wires; the story reports both and does not settle it. Fate conflict: FireLookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed in 1976; the register and the weebly page say removed. Ground cabin vs tower: the register and FireLookout.com both mention a ground cabin, so the design field keeps both. Only one source (a personal history page found by search, not used) mentioned 1935 and 1976 independently; the story relies on WillhiteWeb and FireLookout.com for 1976. The brief lists access 'unknown'; set to public based on the Forest Service trailhead page. The weebly page has no year for its 'Removed' note.
